messages:
ana (product): Quick sync: we need to lock pilot acceptance & guardrails for Optimize toolkit (batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Anchor customer wants advisory-only suggestions, audit trail, and clear SLA for alert delivery. Thoughts?

 tom (swe): Recommend API-only alpha, Dedicated region, no UI. Reuse eval-runner + alert-delivery. Feature-flag per tenant and an opt-out flag. Estimate: 2 sprints for a small squad.

 mei (ml): ML flow: nightly evals on customer prompt set, compute quality delta + latency win for quant candidates, surface top-2 with p50/p95/p99 estimates and a short rationale. Triggers: primary metric drop >=1.5% OR ppl up >=8% with latency win >=20%.

 carlos (solutions): Compliance wants exportable audit records (baseline_eval_id, new_eval_id, recommended_quant, metric_deltas, rationale) and an "advisory-only" contractual line. They also asked for a weekly FP rate target to tune thresholds.

 tom (swe): Acceptance criteria (alpha): nightly evals persist to central store; alerts emitted <10m and delivered to ops + customer webhook + email; audit record persisted and exportable; tenant opt-out prevents external delivery; no auto-rollout.

 ana (product): OK if eng + ML sign off I'll open tickets and schedule kickoff with the anchor customer. React with :white_check_mark: if you agree.

 mei (ml): :white_check_mark:

 tom (swe): :white_check_mark: I'll open the engineering ticket today and add ACs.

 carlos (solutions): :white_check_mark: I'll draft customer-facing wording and compliance export template.

 ci-bot: Branch created: feature/optimize-pilot-guardrails-alpha. CI started.
note: Per agents.md: do not include a title field
